name: What is involved in a plumbing rough-in during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a plumbing rough-in during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A plumbing rough-in involves installing all new water supply and drainage pipes within the walls and floors before they are closed up. This typically includes relocating or adding lines for sinks, toilets, showers, and appliances, ensuring proper connection to the main supply and waste systems. For a kitchen remodel in an older Berkeley home, for example, the existing pipe materials may need assessment, as modern plumbing fixtures often have different pressure and drainage requirements than older systems, potentially necessitating upgrades to the main lines leading to the new fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: A plumbing rough-in installs new water supply and drainage pipes within walls and floors before they are finished. It ensures proper connections for new fixtures.
